verdict.label: separate
verdict.why: scheduleFromDraft turns a form draft into an upsert schedule payload, validating each field and returning null on failure. taskToDraft goes the other way, filling form state from a stored task with defaults. They share domain vocabulary (schedule modes, weekdays, dedupe keys), but the executable steps are different. No validation or normalization policy is repeated in both. taskToDraft does no parsing or range checks, only field mapping and defaults, so there is no concrete reusable operation to extract. Any shared constants or helpers, such as the webhook filter drafts, are already separate utilities.

function taskToDraft(task: ScheduledTask): DraftState {
  const schedule = task.schedule;
  const filters = webhookFilterDrafts(schedule.type === "webhook" ? schedule.filters : undefined);
  const weekdays =
    schedule.type === "fixed_time" && schedule.weekdays && schedule.weekdays.length > 0
      ? new Set(schedule.weekdays)
      : new Set([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
  return {
    editingId: task.id,
    title: task.title,
    prompt: task.prompt,
    enabled: task.enabled,
    scheduleMode: schedule.type === "fixed_time" ? "fixed" : schedule.type,
    intervalMinutes:
      schedule.type === "interval" ? String(Math.max(1, schedule.everyMs / 60_000)) : "15",
    timeOfDay: schedule.type === "fixed_time" ? schedule.timeOfDay : "09:00",
    runAt: schedule.type === "once" ? toDateTimeLocalValue(new Date(schedule.runAt)) : "",
    savedRunAt: schedule.type === "once" ? schedule.runAt : "",
    weekdays,
    projectId: task.projectId,
    threadId: task.threadId ?? "",
    threadMode: scheduledTaskThreadMode(task),
    workspaceMode: task.workspaceStrategy.type,
    baseRef: task.workspaceStrategy.type === "worktree" ? task.workspaceStrategy.baseRef : "main",
    startFromOrigin:
      task.workspaceStrategy.type === "worktree"
        ? (task.workspaceStrategy.startFromOrigin ?? false)
        : true,
    existingWorktreePath:
      task.workspaceStrategy.type === "existing_worktree"
        ? task.workspaceStrategy.worktreePath
        : "",
    modelKey: `${task.modelSelection.instanceId}:${task.modelSelection.model}`,
    runtimeMode: task.runtimeMode,
    interactionMode: task.interactionMode,
    baseModelSelection: task.modelSelection,
    ...(schedule.type === "webhook" && schedule.signature !== null
      ? {
          signatureEnabled: true,
          signatureHeader: schedule.signature.header,
          signatureEncoding: schedule.signature.encoding,
          signaturePrefix: schedule.signature.prefix,
        }
      : { signatureEnabled: false, ...WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_DEFAULTS }),
    signatureSecret: "",
    replayKey: schedule.type === "webhook" ? (schedule.dedupe?.replayKey ?? "") : "",
    coalesceKey: schedule.type === "webhook" ? (schedule.dedupe?.coalesceKey ?? "") : "",
    coalesceWindowSeconds:
      schedule.type === "webhook" && schedule.dedupe?.coalesceWindowSeconds !== undefined
        ? String(schedule.dedupe.coalesceWindowSeconds)
        : "",
    maxDeliveryAgeMinutes:
      schedule.type === "webhook" && schedule.maxDeliveryAgeMinutes != null
        ? String(schedule.maxDeliveryAgeMinutes)
        : "",
    filters,
    savedFilters: filters,
  };
}

source_adjudication.contract: Draft validation/serialization versus persisted task-to-UI initialization are opposite transformations. Date/interval/weekday/webhook vocabulary does not establish common execution contract. Existing parsing/filter helpers already own pieces.
source_adjudication.existing_shared_owner: Mobile settings callers use scheduleFromDraft for validated upsert payload; web ScheduledTaskEditorForm uses taskToDraft to initialize UI. Existing parse/filter/date helpers own narrow utilities, not a duplicated bidirectional transform.
legitimate_variations: Draft-to-payload validates modes, intervals, weekdays and webhook fields; task-to-draft maps stored values and fills defaults.
Jev owner=shared is retained as an observation, but both labels are separate and source establishes no repeated transform policy.
